name: Participate in the Genius Invokation TCG Challenge for a chance to split a total reward of Primogems ×80,000!
description: Olah! Hello, Duelists~ I'm here to play cards with everyone again, and this time I brought many gifts for everyone! In order to allow more Travelers to participate, this season's challenge is divided into 4 phases, each lasting one week! 20,000 Primogems will be awarded each week for a total of 80,000 Primogems! Don't rush, don't rush! Let's take a look at the schedule first, and don't forget to register!
